noSaleDrawer.label: No-sale drawer
noSaleDrawer.desc: Manual cash drawer opening with no checkout on the same device within 2 minutes either side.

deleteAfterCheckout.label: Delete after checkout
deleteAfterCheckout.desc: Item deleted within 2 minutes after checkout started, before the next sale, worth at least 10.

bigDiscount.label: Big discount
bigDiscount.desc: Item or cart discount of 50% or more, or a price cut of 50% or more.

burstDelete.label: Burst deletes
burstDelete.desc: Same staff member deleting items 8 or more times within 10 minutes; one flag per burst.

repeatReprint.label: Repeated reprint
repeatReprint.desc: Same order reprinted 3 or more times in a day; the 3rd reprint is flagged.

offHours.label: Off-hours
offHours.desc: Operations outside 07:00–22:00; the first one per device and period is flagged.

emergencyOverride.label: Emergency override
emergencyOverride.desc: Operations performed under a new-POS emergency override; every one needs review.

evidence.repeatReprint: Order {{order}} reprinted {{count}} times today, first at {{first}}
evidence.deleteAfterTender: Removed {{seconds}}s after payment started at {{at}}, amount {{amount}}
evidence.repeatReprintDay: Reprinted {{count}} times on this device today, first at {{first}}

employees.amountNote: The amount is takings reduced by deletes, price changes, cart discounts and no-receipt returns. Tap a staff card to see their records.
employees.empty: No staff operations in this range
employees.amountNotePos: Amount = total reduction from removals, cart clears, price changes, discounts and refunds (successful only). Tap a card to see that cashier.

rulesPos.noSaleDrawer: Manual drawer open (no order) with no completed sale or refund on the same device within 2 minutes.
rulesPos.deleteAfterCheckout: Checkout starts when payment starts: removal, cart clear or quantity reduction before the sale completed, reducing the total by ≥ 10.
rulesPos.bigDiscount: Discount or price cut ≥ 50% with a saving of ≥ 10.
rulesPos.burstDelete: Same cashier removed ≥ 8 items within 10 minutes; one flag per burst.
rulesPos.repeatReprint: Same receipt reprinted ≥ 3 times; flags the 3rd.
rulesPos.offHours: Operations outside 07:00–22:00 store local time; first one per device and period.
rulesPos.emergencyOverride: Operations performed under a new-POS emergency override; every one needs review.
